name: Elune's Presence reaches every raid member within 40 yards (#1006)
contract: Elune's Presence 680774 (Spell.dbc): Effect0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT (133) BasePoints 19, ImplicitTargetA 56 = TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID, radius index 227 (40 yd), duration index 1 (10 s), RecoveryTime 180000, and MaxAffectedTargets (field 212) = 5, read from /srv/coa/server-data/dbc/Spell.dbc. The tooltip says all party or raid members within 40 yds. Spell::SelectImplicitAreaTargets RandomResizes the target list to MaxAffectedTargets, so a group of seven (caster plus six, converted to a raid by the group step once the party is full) loses two members at random on today's main. The fix zeroes MaxAffectedTargets at load time in AscensionStarcaller::ApplyContracts. Seven fixtures share the spawn location, so all are within 40 yd. Each is asserted to carry the aura: on unfixed code at most five of the seven can, so the assertion fails whichever members are dropped; the fixed code applies it to all seven. The cast is a self cast with no hit roll.
